findings: Setup checks actual returned queues/mappings and prints SQE/CQE sizes, not C-library wrapper ABI layouts. Native ring/sq/cq are auto-layout owned SDK objects, not kernel or liburing structs to cast.
Default mixed constructor mode prepares33 incompatible SQEs without submission; types there must not imply executed operation or individual ABI-size acceptance.
reference_rwf.position explicitly accepts linux.off_t=i64; SPLICE takes u64 value bit-pattern offsets, not loff_t pointers; -1 sentinel is operation-specific.
reference_signals actually retains/restores kernel masks: native x86_64 linux.sigset_t is8bytes, unlike1024-bit glibc/musl signal-set ABI; not a128-byte kernel argument.

mode_t is u32, Statx.mode is u16, OpenHow.mode is u64; byte widths matching in some fields do not collapse these semantic boundaries. File tests currently assert bytes/size, not mode bits; no new permissions-effect claim.
Raw Linux msghdr uses usize iovlen/controllen on current target; do not assume every POSIX/musl libc header layout matches.
Pointer mutability, byte storage versus retained nested vector metadata, size_t versus u32 SQE len and sockaddr input versus socklen_t value-result output need separate scopes.
